claims.text: Serial intratympanic injections may help some pts and avoid systemic glucocorticoid adverse effects;
claims.quote: Serial intratympanic injections of glucocorticoids (eg, dexamethasone) may also be helpful in some patients and avoids the systemic side effects of oral glucocorticoids
Follow-up with serial audiometry is recommended after intratympanic injections to monitor for hearing loss.
